metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Ante Sundharaniki
metas.description: A Hindu Brahmin falls for a Christian girl and they both lie to their parents, only for their lies to be revealed.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Writer Padmabhushan
metas.description: Padmabhushan, a 25-year-old aspiring writer based out of Vijayawada and his middle class family take us on a roller coaster ride packed with innocuous fun and soft emotions, with their heart in the right place.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Subham
metas.description: Set in the early 2000s, in the pre-internet days of coastal Bheemili, A group of married men band together to find solutions, after their wives get possessed while watching a cable TV soap opera serial.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2022 · DJ Tillu
metas.description: A lazy young man spends his time chasing girls, until an incident changes his life forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2023 · Mem Famous
metas.description: After a shattering event that leaves three reckless lazing youngster friends with no hope and mounting debts, the trio must finally pull up their socks and do something worthwhile despite their incompetence.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Keedaa Cola
metas.description: A hilarious group takes on a challenge of a lifetime when they decide to make quick money by planting a cockroach into a soft drink bottle. Will they hit the jackpot?

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2024 · Maruthi Nagar Subramanyam
metas.description: A father and son experience a sudden influx of wealth in their bank account, leading to comical mishaps and carefree escapades as they navigate their newfound riches.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Mad
metas.description: Set in an engineering college and revolves around the antics of the students there, primarily the boys, who get a kick out of torturing the hostel warden.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Swag
metas.description: Follows the swaganika bloodline which changes the matriarchal society to patriarchal society.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Namo
metas.description: Nagesh and Mohan venture into the forest to persuade Nagesh's Naxalite father to return home, but become trapped in a tribal den surrounded by natives.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · The Great Pre-Wedding Show
metas.description: A young couple navigates the chaotic world of pre-wedding photography, facing unexpected hurdles and family drama as they try to capture their perfect moments before tying the knot.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Jigris
metas.description: The story revolves around four friends embarking on an unexpected road trip in a rusty Maruti 800.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2023 · Rajugari Kodipulao
metas.description: A group of friends ended up hopelessly in a deep forest during their reunion trip. Were they spookily haunted by a monstrous animal with a mischievous sense of humor, or was the monster just one of them, trying to scare the rest silly?

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2024 · Music Shop Murthy
metas.description: Murthy, a man in his early 50s passionate about music, runs a music shop, faces pressure from his family to close the shop due to its lack of profitability. After a chance meeting with Anjana, Murthy delves into the challenging and exciting process of becoming a DJ and ventures to Hyderabad to achieve his dream against all odds.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Eesaraina!?
metas.description: In a village where success depends on government exams, Raju must choose: follow his love for Shirisha despite her father's disapproval or stay on the family farm. As he navigates love and ambition, he wonders-can love conquer all? Will his dreams lead to success? And do exam results define his future? This heartfelt, humorous tale explores the balance between love and ambition.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2024 · Veeranjaneyulu Vihara Yatra
metas.description: A dysfunctional family sets off on a road trip to immerse the grandfather's ashes in Goa and drama ensues.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Mathu Vadalara 2
metas.description: Babu and Yesu, former delivery agents, embark on a thrilling mission as special agents, facing extraordinary challenges with humor, surprises, and nonstop excitement.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · Samajavaragamana
metas.description: A lifelong university student struggling to pass his exams enlists the help of his son and his lovestruck friend. Hijinks ensue amidst blossoming love and comic bust-ups.
